fullYear.title: The Full Year Bundle
fullYear.blurb: Every unit in the store, lesson decks and practice decks, plus every new unit as it's released at no extra cost. The price goes up as units are added; buy once and you get them all.
fullYear.time: About 90–126 class periods once all nine units are in (roughly 18–26 weeks)

units.title: The Age of Rebirth
units.blurb: From Florence to the Reformation: patrons, humanism, the Renaissance man and the Church's loss of authority, taught one idea per slide with built-in turn-and-talks.

units.title: The Age of Exploration
units.blurb: Dias, Columbus, da Gama and Magellan: the key terms, people and places of the voyages, with practice that ends in primary source analysis and Claim, Evidence, Reasoning writing.

units.title: Lantern of Reason
units.blurb: Hobbes, Locke, Montesquieu and Rousseau: natural rights, the social contract and separation of powers, with practice that builds to primary source analysis and Claim, Evidence, Reasoning writing.

units.title: The Last King
units.blurb: Louis XVI, the Estates and the road from Versailles to the Republic, with practice that builds from recall to cause-and-effect sorting, primary sources and Claim, Evidence, Reasoning writing.

units.title: The Industrial Revolution
units.blurb: Inventions, inventors, factories and cities: the key terms, people and places of the Industrial Revolution, with practice that ends in primary source analysis and Claim, Evidence, Reasoning writing.

units.title: The Age of Imperialism
units.blurb: The Scramble for Africa and the Great Game in Asia: the key terms, people and places of imperialism, with practice that ends in primary source analysis and Claim, Evidence, Reasoning writing.

units.title: World War I
units.blurb: The causes, fronts and turning points of the Great War: the key terms, people and places, with practice that ends in primary source analysis and Claim, Evidence, Reasoning writing.

units.title: World War II
units.blurb: The key terms, people and places of World War II, with practice that ends in primary source analysis and Claim, Evidence, Reasoning writing.
